newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Dec 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia, Japan sign three technology transfer agreements this year, Japanese official says.
- Saudi Arabia to set up first hotel management and tourism institute in Jeddah.
- Murdered Australian nurse had been lending money to colleagues.
- Saudi Consolidated Electricity Company - East (SCECO-East) plans projects worth 600 million riyals in 1997.
- Saudi's Real Estate Development Fund agrees to extend loans worth 500 million riyals to citizens in the financial year which ends in June, 1997.
- Saudi Interior Minister Prince Nayef urges the private sector to employ more Saudi nationals.
- Gulf Arab states' manufacturing industry needs $1.5 billion to maintain workforce growth, a Gulf official says.
